intro: Noodles & Company is the fast-casual chain built entirely around noodles and pasta, from around the world: American Wisconsin Mac & Cheese, Italian Pesto Cavatappi and Penne Rosa, Thai-style Pad Thai and Japanese Pan Noodles, all made to order with your choice of added protein. Below is the full Noodles & Company menu with prices for 2026.
quick_answer: At Noodles & Company, a regular Wisconsin Mac & Cheese is about $7.35, Pad Thai $7.75, Pesto Cavatappi $7.50, and Penne Rosa $7.50. Loaded dishes like Crispy Chicken Bacon Alfredo run about $12.95, and added proteins (grilled chicken, steak, shrimp) are $4 to $4.25 extra. Small sizes are about $1 less. The Wisconsin Mac & Cheese and Pad Thai are the signatures.
hot_deal: Noodles & Company value: Buttered Noodles ($7.00) and the small sizes (about $1 less than regular) are the cheapest ways in, and Pasta Fresca ($7.25) is a good-value lighter dish. Noodles Rewards and the app drop regular deals, sometimes dishes under $8. Adding a protein is $4 to $4.25. Prices vary by location.

faqs.q: How much is mac and cheese at Noodles & Company?
faqs.a: A regular Wisconsin Mac & Cheese is about $7.35 and a small is $6.10. Loaded versions like Buffalo Chicken Mac ($12.10) and BBQ Chicken Mac ($11.85) cost more. A side of mac is $2.85. Prices vary by location.

faqs.q: What is Noodles & Company known for?
faqs.a: Noodles & Company is a fast-casual chain built entirely around noodles and pasta from around the world, from the signature Wisconsin Mac & Cheese to Pad Thai, Pesto Cavatappi, Penne Rosa and Japanese Pan Noodles, each made to order with an optional added protein.

faqs.q: How much does it cost to add a protein at Noodles & Company?
faqs.a: Adding a protein is about $3.75 for seasoned tofu, $4.00 for grilled chicken or meatballs, and $4.25 for marinated steak, shrimp or parmesan-crusted chicken. You can add it to any noodle dish or salad.

Noodles & Company publishes nutrition on its website and in store, but item calories are not reproduced here and are left blank rather than guessed. The chain offers lighter options, smaller sizes, and a build-your-own approach, so totals vary a lot.

faqs.q: What are the most popular dishes at Noodles & Company?
faqs.a: Favorites include the Wisconsin Mac & Cheese, Pad Thai, Pesto Cavatappi, Penne Rosa, and the Japanese Pan Noodles.
